honesty_boundary: There is NO golden folder report in this workspace (product/verify/README.md section 9), and task A-3 is forbidden from invoking the Oracle. Every `expected_statuses` map is therefore either (a) read out of the one Oracle artifact that exists for the audit tree pair plus the criteria measurement in product/docs/00-current-state.md section 6, or (b) computed by this file's independent Python reference model over the same generated bytes. Neither is a measured BC parity claim: the cases record THIS ENGINE'S committed behaviour under the observed criteria model. The project lead's serial Oracle pass is what upgrades a case from predicted to verified.
